newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli-backed militiaman killed in Lebanon ambush.
newsitem.headline: Israeli-backed militiaman killed in Lebanon ambush.

text.p: An Israeli-backed militiaman was killed on Saturday when guerrillas ambushed his patrol in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
They said a South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia patrol came under guerrilla fire near the village of Markaba in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
One militiaman died in the attack, the sources said.
No group immediately claimed responsibility but pro-Iranian and Syrian-backed guerrillas have recently stepped up their campaign to drive Israeli troops and their allies from south Lebanon.
